Summary: Oman and Iran have agreed to establish a joint working group to discuss the future management of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, including services provided in the waterway and associated costs. In a joint statement, the two countries said the group, formed between their foreign ministries, would continue dialogue on issues related to the strait and seek an agreement in line with international standards. The statement followed talks in Muscat where both sides pledged to continue co-operation on maritime safety, freedom of navigation and regional stability.
